#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long nrs[16];

long long compute_cost(long long k, int i, int bm) {
    if (k == 0) return 0;
    long long l = k;
    l = (l % nrs[i] + nrs[i]) % nrs[i];
    if (bm % 2) l -= nrs[i];
    long long cost = (abs(k - l) / nrs[i]) * (i + 1);
    return cost + compute_cost(l, i - 1, bm / 2);
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    nrs[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 16; ++i)
        nrs[i] = nrs[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    long long answer = n;
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 15); ++mask) {
        answer = min(answer, compute_cost(n, 15, mask));
    }
    cout << answer << '\n';
}
